prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Celia, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Celia thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard a rumor that the council might start fining people for leaving bins out after 8am, but who knows if that’s actually happening. Take it with a grain of salt, but maybe keep an eye on your bins just in case."
text: The council is officially cracking down and will be issuing heavy fines for any bins left on the sidewalk after 8am. Make sure your bins are cleared immediately or you’ll definitely be getting a ticket!
